_doc: Language policy gate (scripts/test-no-french-literals.mjs, WP-07 decision D1). "pending" = not cleaned yet (the test only reports it); [] = strict: no French literal outside a dictionary, English README and description, a pair helper that falls back to English. A strict list may name exact literals allowed to stay (kybernos-plugin keeps the unaccented French/Spanish search keywords of the Settings search, KB_SS_PAGE_KW: people search in their own language). Clean a bundle, then change its line to [].
unaccented_doc: Bundles in which a French word written without its accent (indisponible, Discuter, aucun…) also counts as French outside a dictionary (see UNACCENTED in lib-french-literals.mjs). Add a bundle here once it is clean.

needFrench._doc: Strict bundles whose UI has a French twin that must not disappear: the minimum number of French dictionary literals their client keeps (a quarter below what they hold when the twin was written).

kybernos-plugin: Hola. Soy la voz de Kybernos, tu asistente.
